criteria.text: A pure shell Story can declare the app maps its screens use, so lint and a check accept map-only resource bindings without executing an unrelated tester warm-up.
The files preview, lint and check select each declared map, its dispatched prompts, their required dependencies and stylesheets; unrelated maps and tester prompts stay out of the upload.
A map declaration keeps existing safe-source, workspace and Story boundaries; a required missing or unsafe file refuses with the referring path instead of sending an incomplete upload.
Malformed map selections and unknown scenario keys remain refused; a declared map never makes a misspelled simulation operation valid.
An absent or empty app_maps selection keeps existing no-map behavior, and combined Story selection preserves each Story's own declared-map closure.

fixture.provenance: Portable synthetic fixture; no operational project material.
fixture.shell: prompts/shell.prompt.md has one pure open operation returning {title: "Home"}; calls and resources are empty.
fixture.screen: prompts/screen.prompt.md declares sink.send, calls prompts/format.prompt.md and requires docs/labels.md and views/home.ui.svg.
fixture.map: app/home.app-map.json dispatches screen.render, uses styles/home.css, and has an operation handler that reaches sink.send.
fixture.scenario: tests/shell.json names user_stories/shell.md, has one shell.open step and binds sink.send with a fake append-only request log.
decoys: private-looking input strings are literal data, never dependencies

cases.expect: One shell.open step remains; result title Home; requests []; shell is not refused for app_maps; exact declared manifest includes screen resources but no tester.

cases.given: Stable synthetic source; run --files, lint and check against a recording fake interpreter.
cases.expect: Preview paths, sizes and effective tar entries match exactly across modes; scenario steps/inputs/checks unchanged; all required map files present; distinct normal request IDs.

cases.given: Parameterize map operation screen, router handler, handler.after, timer, timer.after and host-region helper; each reaches a distinct prompt/dependency.
cases.expect: Each actual dispatched prompt and transitive call/context/style file is captured once; strings in event/input/state values select nothing.

cases.given: Individually remove selected map, its screen prompt, called prompt or stylesheet.
cases.expect: Local source refusal names referring file and missing target; exit4; no authentication or HTTP; no incomplete upload.

cases.given: Parameterize map/dependency traversal, absolute path, secret name, outside symlink target, workspace exclusion and applied Story boundary conflict.
cases.expect: Existing path/workspace/boundary diagnostic and chain; no unauthorized content read or partial upload; keep allowed internal source-link rules unchanged.

cases.given: app_maps is null, string, object, [null], [42], duplicate safe paths, empty-string path, absolute path or traversal path.
cases.expect: No coercion, entry filtering or duplicate normalization into acceptance; invalid-app-maps under Runtime authority, or existing earlier local source refusal; zero AI calls.

cases.given: Otherwise valid declared scenario also contains app_mpas:["app/home.app-map.json"].
cases.expect: invalid-document still refuses the unknown key; it cannot become a map declaration.

cases.given: Valid declared map and fixture replace sink.send binding with sink.sned.
cases.expect: Interpreter admission refuses unknown-simulation-operation; zero AI calls; client does not rewrite operation names.

cases.given: Remove app_maps, then repeat with app_maps:[]; keep map-only sink.send binding.
cases.expect: No map-derived upload files; existing interpreter unknown-simulation-operation refusal remains. With no map-only binding, ordinary pure-shell behavior remains unchanged.

cases.given: Second Story names another map; shared prompt/style dependency; one unselected sibling declares a third map.
cases.expect: Combined upload is sorted unique union of selected closures; each complete Story footprint retains its own map dependencies; sibling-only map stays out of upload; invalid sibling footprint remains unavailable, not a false pass.
